$description: Vantage design tokens — W3C Design Tokens format, generated from src/ui/theme.js (Linear 'midnight precision instrument' reference). Import into Figma with a variables-import plugin (e.g. 'Tokens Studio' or 'Variables Import/Export') to get an editable variable collection. theme.js stays the source of truth: regenerate this file when the theme changes.

surface.$description: The documented 0-3 elevation ladder. Depth comes from this progression plus hairline borders, never from ambient shadow.

obsidian.$description: Level 2 - elevated panels, inputs, nested surfaces

slate.$description: Level 3 - interactive surface tint, ghost button fills

bone.$description: Near-white surface fills, high-contrast button text

mist.$description: Body text, button labels on dark

accent.$description: Acid lime is the ONLY chromatic UI element: the single primary action per view. Never decoration, never a secondary button, never data.

acid-lime.$description: Primary action fills, active nav indicators

lime-press.$description: Pressed state of the primary action

lime-dim.$description: Border weight of the accent - 3.4:1 on void

signal-teal.$description: Informational icon fills - supporting accent only

iris-violet.$description: Tag and badge fills - supporting accent only

data.$description: The documented deviation from the reference: a market terminal needs semantic direction colours, so the palette's green and red are used for price direction. Coral doubles as the on-air state, separated from 'down' by treatment (solid fill + dot vs plain text).

down.$description: Falling price, on-air, danger - 5.6:1 on void

down-dim.$description: Border weight for falling / live state

on-fill.$description: Label colour on any lime or coral fill - 5.6:1 or better

radius.$description: The entire radius vocabulary. Nothing rounds past 12 except pills.

spacing.$description: 4px base unit; the 8/12/24/96 ladder carries the page rhythm.

type.$description: Two faces. Inter carries UI and headings with cv01/ss03/zero alternates on; IBM Plex Mono (standing in for Berkeley Mono) is reserved for instrument metadata - eyebrows, tickers, IDs, column headers. Weights stay in the 400-590 band; the system never bolds.

shadow.$description: Borders do the work shadows usually would. Only two real shadows exist, plus the inset stack the reference reserves for the lime CTA.
